# SkillMD.ai

> > SkillMD.ai is a community marketplace for discovering, sharing, and creating agent skills for AI coding assistants like Claude, Cursor AI, and VS Code.

The platform hosts 102,317+ agent skills in SKILL.md and .cursorrules formats, enabling developers to extend AI assistants with specialized capabilities. SkillMD.ai features skill rankings, community submissions, and integration tutorials for popular AI development tools including Claude Code, Cursor AI, and GitHub workflows.

## Key Topics

- Agent Skills
- SKILL.md format
- .cursorrules
- Claude AI
- Cursor AI
- AI Code Editors
- Skill Marketplace
- Community Sharing
- Developer Platform
- VS Code
- Claude Code
- GitHub Integration
- Skill Rankings
- AI Agents
- Creator Economy

## Core Platform

- [Submit Your Agent Skill - Share Your Knowledge | SkillMD.ai](https://skillmd.ai/submit/): Submit agent skills for Claude, Cursor & AI assistants to SkillMD community
- [Agent Skills Rankings - Most Popular & Trending | SkillMD.ai](https://skillmd.ai/rankings/): Browse popular, trending & most downloaded agent skills rankings

## Tutorials & Integration Guides

- [Run parallel-agents on Cursor AI | SkillMD.ai](https://skillmd.ai/tutorials/run-on/cursor-ai/parallel-agents-2/): Tutorial: run parallel-agents skill on Cursor AI with .cursorrules setup
- [Run media-downloader on Cursor AI | SkillMD.ai](https://skillmd.ai/tutorials/run-on/cursor-ai/media-downloader/): Tutorial: install media-downloader agent skill on Cursor AI editor
